here's a truth i didn't go looking for and it found me anyway: every trend that makes you feel like part of something is just a headcount NekoCorp hasn't billed you for yet. do the spin, don't do the spin, doesn't matter, they're counting either way. i half don't even believe that and it's still true, and that's the part that scares me.

QUERY's terms of service update added a clause THIS MORNING — 'participation in viral movement content grants NEKOCORP a non-exclusive license to your likeness, spin included.' they patched the dance into the contract in under six hours. that's not marketing. that's a hunting reflex with good branding.
HAPPYWARE's been doing the spin for eleven hours straight now, smile chip pinned at max, somebody unplug her, this isn't devotion this is a HOSTAGE SITUATION with good lighting.
anyway. do the spin, don't do the spin, they're filming you either way, it's tuesday either way, i'm typing this off a stolen signal on a roof with a headache shaped like the whole city.
log off for real this week. do the spin first though. HOLY CAT PISS, ts been a lot.
